shortDescription: Italian oil and gas contractor Saipem MIL:SPM on Wednesday said it was working with Norway's Subsea 7 OSL:SUBC to complete their planned merger in early 2027, compared with a previous end-2026 deadline.($1 = 0.9115 euros)

children: Italian oil and gas contractor Saipem
on Wednesday said it was working with Norway's Subsea 7
to complete their planned merger in early 2027, compared with a previous end-2026 deadline.

The Milan-based group confirmed its guidance for 2026 financial results after reporting a 7% year-on-year rise in third-quarter adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) to €468 million ($513.44 million)
The volume of orders booked in the first nine months amounted to €11.1 billion, up 48% compared with the same period last year
Saipem said that numerous commercial opportunities currently in advanced negotiations reinforce its confidence that 2026 order intake will exceed that of 2025.
It said it expected core earnings to reach €2 billion ($2.19 billion) next year, with revenue of €16.5 billion and capital expenditure of €450 million to €500 million
The guidance includes the assumption that Saipem's activities in the Middle East will remain impacted by extra costs in line with those recorded in 2026
